cohort: Women who underwent obstetric hysterectomy between 2011 and 2020
finding: Caesarean delivery, previous LSCS, grand multiparity, placenta previa and obstructed labour were significant risk factors for obstetric hysterectomy, with hemorrhage being the leading cause of maternal mortality.
mod_finding: Obstetric hysterectomy was associated with caesarean delivery in 79.04% of cases, compared to 20.95% for vaginal delivery.
